title: Verify model capabilities with a bounded development-only pilot
description:
## Scope

Use a small fixed development fixture to check Jev, Kev, and Laya loading, label parsing, context serialization, maximum useful context, latency, and probability availability. Record versions/hardware and separate installation/download/model-call steps. Freeze a small preflight and ceiling before explicitly approved live calls; never involve scoreboard rows.

## Definition of done

A compatibility report records successful zero-shot/few-shot paths or precise exclusions, observed context limits, and real usage; adapter defects are linked back to core issues.
